source.text: 6.5 If delivery is delayed beyond the Delivery Deadline, the first four (4) calendar days of delay shall not attract a late-delivery penalty. From the next day, a penalty of 2.5% of the value of the delayed Equipment shown on the relevant Invoice shall apply for each day of delay, subject to an aggregate ceiling of 15% of that Invoice value.

deadline_source.text: 6.2 For Orders governed by this Agreement, the required delivery date is 31 January 2027 (the “Delivery Deadline”), unless a later or different date is expressly agreed in a written amendment signed by both Parties.

source.text: 8.2 A single Order containing 30 or more units qualifies for a volume discount of 7% on the Equipment value of that Order.
The Buyer shall pay each valid and undisputed Invoice within 28 days of the invoice date.
The agreed unit price for each Dell UltraSharp U2723QE Monitor is PKR 85,000 per unit. The Vendor shall ensure that the unit amount shown on an Invoice does not exceed that agreed figure.
